fact: On a field visit to Bepowase, Ayensuano District, during Birth Registration Month, the Eastern Regional Registrar named poor internet connectivity as a major operational challenge in communities where officers are expected to complete digital registrations, and the assembly member said the absence of network coverage makes birth registration very difficult because it has been digitalised.
title: UNICEF, BDR and Kuami Eugene push for improved birth registration in Bepowase
